referenceRole: Viewed fresh Ranch V12 and old connected V01 only as style references; entirely new native illustrations

specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE isolated transparent-background 2D game decoration sprite for ANIMOL Starway Ranch, not a scene or sprite atlas.
Style/medium: bold graphic Western TV cartoon environment with crisp near-black navy outlines, flat cel shading, angular silhouettes. Thick sharp outer contour, thinner sparse interior descriptive lines. Shape design uses long straight runs, triangles, trapezoids, wedges and clear direction changes. Broad clean base color plus only one hard polygonal shadow per material. NO painterly texture, airbrushing, soft gradients, 3D rendering, noise, pixel art, soft balloon curves, circular emblems or rounded clover petals.
Camera: orthogonal square ground plane viewed from above with a short front face, sides parallel to image horizontal/vertical. No isometric diamond footprint, no diagonal composition.
Palette: cream-painted timber with emerald green trim, mint and sage green foliage, vivid warm yellow hay and angular flowers, purple/slate stone, very dark navy outlines. Keep materials 2–3 flat tonal steps.
Composition: one complete whole prop, centered and fully visible with transparent margins. Native source must supply all drawn art; no labels, grid, shadows outside the inherent base, letters, numbers, UI, people or live animals. No moons, planets, suns or astronomy motifs.
Important angular details: prismatic square posts, diamond bolts, polygon handles, folded geometric sacks, segmented straight rope bends. No round rope coils, cylinders, rounded petals or tiny realistic decoration.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha cutout.
Primary request: a low cream-and-emerald hay storage rack occupying an entire wide 2-by-1 rectangular ground area. Two large angular golden hay bales strapped with flat emerald bands, a small cream timber supply crate integrated at one end, all resting on one low straight cream timber/slate foundation. Give it a broad clear horizontal silhouette and short front face. Rectangular bale blocks with wedge cut hay ends, not cylinders. Entire base must be wide, almost 2:1, fill the full width. Avoid overly tall piles or floating props.
